About AURA:

We are developing AURA (Autonomous Unified Remote Assessment) for NASA Space Apps—an autonomous system monitoring health metrics and environmental safety for astronauts.

Looking for teammates skilled in:

• Embedded Systems & Electronics (Microcontrollers, Sensors)

• Software & UI/UX (Dashboards)

• Data Analysis & AI (Telemetry)

• Pitching & Documentation
